bindingRules: Treat the six approved modules as one coordinated fitted-kitchen family.
Never regenerate a whole module to make a later state; derive state components over the same approved base.
Do not infer production cell bounds from the review-sheet grid. Production extraction receives a separate exact-geometry gate.
Remove the review backdrop during production extraction without repainting, smoothing or redrawing the approved objects.
Loose countertop objects are a later coordinated family and are not part of this approval.
rollback: Discard this source-foundation directory and its external approval record. Historical approved and production assets remain byte-identical.
